query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM (
            (SELECT id, kind, night, s, price, h, r, o1, o2, gx, gy FROM place_dot_sources
             EXCEPT ALL
             SELECT place_id, kind, night, s, price, h, r, o1, o2, gx, gy FROM place_dot_members)
            UNION ALL
            (SELECT place_id, kind, night, s, price, h, r, o1, o2, gx, gy FROM place_dot_members
             EXCEPT ALL
             SELECT id, kind, night, s, price, h, r, o1, o2, gx, gy FROM place_dot_sources)
        ) d
